verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças holds taxpayer data, so data storage location is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence says users can choose a storage region or residency. The cited items cover only notifications, communication channels, tax and customs services, login and site-availability notices, and none concern data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
